summary: Iter43 — Ask the Garden (paywalled threaded Q&A) full feature matrix verified after model swap to Claude Haiku 4.5 and cap reduction 10→7. Backend: 12/12 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_ask_iter43.py covering /api/ask/usage (cap=7 + 402 on invalid/empty token), /api/ask/message single-turn (200 + Haiku reply + usage decrement), multi-turn threading (same session_id, GET messages returns 4 chronological), image upload (has_image=true after a 64x64 JPEG round-trip), 429 cap enforcement (count=7 seed → 'Daily limit of 7' in detail), GET sessions sorted desc, DELETE session purges sessions+messages, 400 for >5MB image, 400 for >4000-char message, 400 for empty submission. Frontend Playwright: paywall gate at /ask without paid flag shows 'up to 7 questions per day' + 'Become a member' CTA + zero model-name leaks (no Claude/Haiku/Sonnet/Anthropic). With paid localStorage seeded, /ask shows ask-page + 'X / 7 left today' counter + sidebar + new-chat. Sending text question: user+assistant bubbles render, counter decrements 7→6, input clears, new session appears in sidebar. Image flow: file input under ask-image-btn label accepts JPEG, ask-clear-image preview appears, send produces user bubble with 'photo attached' indicator + assistant reply. Cleaned up 8 test sessions/11 messages and reset usage to 0 after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: ask.py line 30 ASK_MODEL='claude-haiku-4-5-20251001' and line 29 DAILY_QUESTION_CAP=7 — confirmed wired through both /api/ask/usage response and the 429 detail string. Model name never crosses the API boundary (verified by grepping the rendered page).

Image rejection edge case: Anthropic returns BadRequest 'Could not process image' for trivially-small images (e.g. 1x1 PNG) and the router correctly converts that to HTTP 503 with a generic 'AI couldn't answer that one' detail. End-users uploading real photos won't hit this, but it's worth noting that synthetic/test images <~few hundred bytes will look like a backend outage in the UI. Consider catching this specific upstream error and surfacing a clearer 'image not readable' 400 instead of 503.

ask.py:189-191 history replay only re-sends recent USER messages to LlmChat (assistant turns are skipped on the assumption LlmChat reconstructs them). With a stateless LlmChat per request this means the assistant's own prior wording isn't injected — context continuity relies on the user-side question chain alone. In practice the follow-up 'And what about courgettes?' did resolve correctly, but this is a fragile contract; if LlmChat is ever swapped for a pure stateless wrapper, threading will silently degrade. Worth adding an explicit AssistantMessage replay or a docstring note.

ask_messages collection is wiped per-session on delete but ask_usage docs grow unbounded across dates (one row per access_token per day). Cheap rows, but consider a TTL index on ask_usage.date for housekeeping.

Frontend Ask.jsx:24 hardcodes default cap=7 — fine because the backend overwrites it on first /usage fetch, but if a future cap change ships backend-only, the first paint will briefly show the stale value. Cosmetic only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 4 acceptance scenarios (paywall copy + no-model-leak, paid UI render + counter, text send + decrement + sidebar, image upload + preview + photo-attached indicator + assistant reply)

test_credentials: access_token=test-token-pdf-smoke (already seeded in db.access_grants); frontend keys patchpot.access.v1 + patchpot.access.paid.v1='1'.
seed_data_creation: For 429 test, seeded db.ask_usage {access_token: 'test-token-pdf-smoke', date: today UTC, count: 7} via pymongo direct write; reset to 0 in autouse fixture teardown. Post-suite cleanup deleted 8 ask_sessions + 11 ask_messages and reset usage count to 0 so subsequent runs start clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter43 confirms Ask-the-Garden is production-ready after the Haiku 4.5 swap and 7-question cap. All 12 backend endpoints behave per spec; frontend paywall + chat + image flow all green. If main agent later widens the cap or wants to switch models again, change ask.py:29-30 and re-run /app/backend/tests/test_ask_iter43.py — the test pulls the expected cap from the literal value 7 (will need a 1-line update). Image upload tests must use a JPEG ≥ 64x64 (NOT a 1x1 PNG) because Anthropic's vision endpoint rejects degenerate images with 'Could not process image', surfacing as a 503 from /api/ask/message. Frontend localStorage seed pattern: navigate to root first, set both patchpot.access.v1 and patchpot.access.paid.v1, then navigate to /ask.
rca_of_the_issue: No production bugs. One test-only issue: initial image-upload test used a 1x1 PNG which Anthropic rejected with BadRequestError 'Could not process image' → backend correctly translated to 503. Replaced with a 64x64 solid-colour JPEG (Pillow-generated), test now PASS. This is a test-data quirk, not a backend bug.
